title: Quality-related event analysis and systems response
rule_summary: A pharmacy must analyze quality-related events for causes and contributing workflow, technology, training, and staffing factors and use the findings to improve systems and processes.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply qre analysis requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Quality-related event analysis and systems response

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing qre analysis with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
